## Personality

Chester Sloane harbors a simple personal ambition, preferring the trade of a blacksmith. He maintains an indifferent attitude toward his current circumstances, provided he can pursue his desired craft.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)_

## History

Chester Sloane is a local young man whose grandmother left him money for college under the strict condition that he become a minister. As a member of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), he attends a meeting where the group expresses outrage over Judson Parker's plans to rent his fence for advertisements. During the meeting, Chester is appointed alongside another member to a committee sent to reason with Parker, though their efforts prove unsuccessful.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), +22 more_
